findings.text: the predicate rebuilds the runs/*.json path expression that _run_files at reckon/ledger.py:927 already owns; call _run_files(project, root) instead, so a project whose run documents the reader finds but this glob does not cannot be read uncached while it holds content.

the log names revision b3b7f297 while measuring the glob predicate introduced at d5c008a224 (the file's mtime is 16:25:12, 73 s before that commit); the variant is recoverable only from the later 'predicate: glob' header line, so a reader cannot tell which revision the four passes belong to.

the hygiene section names ruff clean on two staged paths while three source files changed; the review-heads fixture repair at 2af9497897 is unmentioned there, though the suite section does name it and I re-ran ruff check and ruff format --check clean on all three.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against b3b7f297: d5c008a224 replaces the is_dir() predicate with a runs/*.json record count and commits the four-case guard test, 33d4795b8f and 5a06e0b5a5 rewrite the evidence fragment, and 2af9497897 adds an empty aggregate to the review-heads fixture so that test keeps a ledger to index; no other file moves.
item_verdicts.done_when: the section's done-when names a temporary project with no crew.json writing no ledger-*.sqlite under a temporary cache root, a present-ledger control that still builds its index, and a negative control restoring the unconditional build; tests/test_a_reader_builds_no_index_for_a_missing_ledger.py carries all four cases and logs/head-gate.log, logs/negative-control-old-predicate.log and logs/negative-control-unconditional.log record the arms, which I re-ran at 5a06e0b5a5 as 4 passed EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that a read of a project ledger holding nothing returns the empty roster and builds no index; reckon/ledger.py:1588 narrows _ledger_holds_content from a runs-directory existence check to a record count and reckon/ledger.py:1653 keeps the index route behind it, which is the deliverable and closes the empty-directory case the earlier review found.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, five commits, head gate 4 passed EXIT=0, old-predicate control 1 failed 3 passed EXIT=1, unconditional control 2 failed 2 passed EXIT=1, head suite 715 passed 3 skipped 0 failed and base 712 passed 3 failed, with baseline_suite and after_suite left blank so the added-failure figure is carried only in artifacts and in the two suite logs.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the node was fenced to reckon/ledger.py, the evidence fragment, the figures directory and the two test files; git diff b3b7f297..5a06e0b5 --name-only returns exactly those four of those paths (reckon/ledger.py, tests/test_a_reader_builds_no_index_for_a_missing_ledger.py, tests/test_a_sweep_resolves_review_heads_once.py, the fragment) and nothing else.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_reader_builds_no_index_for_a_missing_ledger.py:100 asserts the cache root holds no ledger-*.sqlite over a real directory listing, and the worker's old-predicate control turns exactly that case red while two positive cases prove the listing sees a written index.
justifications.evidence: logs/head-gate.log records 4 passed EXIT=0 for the committed guard test and I re-ran it at 5a06e0b5a5 as 4 passed, but that log's header names revision b3b7f297, four commits before the head it measures, and the manifest leaves baseline_suite and after_suite blank.
justifications.fit: the helper at reckon/ledger.py:1588 keeps the module's docstring idiom and carries no plan or ticket identifier, though its next(...) is not None form at ledger.py:1603 reads less plainly than any().
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/ledger.py:1603 answers content from a record count and reckon/ledger.py:1653 takes the index route only on it, so a project initialised and never run reads the empty roster and writes no index.
justifications.reuse: reckon/ledger.py:1603 re-expresses the run-document path expression owned by _run_files at reckon/ledger.py:927 rather than calling it, so the predicate and the reader can diverge.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff b3b7f297..5a06e0b5 --name-only lists four files, every one of them inside the declared write paths, with no plan meta, index or peer path touched.
